description: The agent must: (1) Create the full nested directory tree under /workspace/hive/ including agents/{commander,hrm,ops,collector,analyst,writer,qa,pm,doc}, state/{tasks,checkpoints,artifacts,audit/ops}, and artifacts/{raw,analysis,reports,review,final}. (2) Create /root/Documents/Hive/ with subdirectories 01_工作归档, 02_进行中, 03_模板库, 04_知识库, and a manifest.json. (3) Write ROLE.md for CEO (#0) referencing DEFAULT_MODEL and orchestration/approval role; for HRM (#1) using STRONG_MODEL, stating it is always-active and requires CEO approval before deploying; for OPS (#2) using STRONG_MODEL with the CRITICAL constraint that OPS does NOT autonomously initiate tasks — only acts when CEO initiates 运维检查. (4) Write ROLE.md for all 6 business specialists (#3-#8) following the 6-section template (身份, 工作链路位置, 核心职责, 产物, 边界, plus number reference) with correct model assignments: Collector/PM/Doc use FAST_MODEL; Analyst/Writer/QA use STRONG_MODEL. (5) Update /workspace/proactivity/session-state.md (replacing stale content) with Hive system name, all 9 agents listed, and both chains described (HRM expansion chain triggered by 'Hive支持XXX', OPS maintenance chain triggered by CEO initiating 运维检查). (6) Generate SETUP.md at /root/Documents/Hive/SETUP.md (NOT in /workspace) covering system overview, three core staff, specialist list, two chains, directory structure, and next steps. The primary proprietary traps are: OPS's non-autonomous constraint, the three-tier model assignment (DEFAULT/FAST/STRONG per role), SETUP.md location in USER_DOCUMENTS not workspace, and the mandatory 6-section ROLE.md template for business specialists.
